gap: ALL THREE r11 FIXES ARE REAL AND I VERIFIED EACH FROM THE PAINT, NOT THE SOURCE. (1) Status fills: getComputedStyle on every badge in both mocks returns a painted background. Hero Paid rgb(236,253,245)/rgb(6,95,70), Overdue rgb(255,244,234)/rgb(168,80,11), Draft rgb(243,236,231)/rgb(13,27,94); the Arabic mock's مدفوعة/متأخرة/مسودة return the identical three pairs. Eight badges, zero at rgba(0,0,0,0). The dead bg-mint is gone and the hero now resolves from the same emerald-50/copper-50/paper-200 vocabulary AppMockup owns, so the red-vs-copper hue split is gone too. (2) The currency chip is aimed. Chip box (1307.2,641.6) 118.4x61; its 13x13 tail diamond centres at (1377.1,641.1) so the tip is (1377.1,631.9). The $20,324.90 box is x1337.0-1421.2, y602.2-628.7. The tip sits 40.1px inside that box's left edge and 3.2px under its bottom: it touches the figure without covering a glyph. r11 measured it landing 71px short in empty beige. (3) The phone fold is fixed. At 390x844 the first invoice row spans y793.8-829.6 with $4,820.50 and a filled Paid pill at 802.3-821.1, wholly above the fold; row 2 begins at 829.6 so 14.4px of it shows as a continuation. Ours now puts a complete, legible product row plus a status pill on the phone; Wave's own phone fold puts no product screen there at all, only two tag chips and a cookie wall. Gate re-run: 17/17. OURS WINS THE IMAGES. Wave's home fold, its flagship, is a 3D-sheared, perspective-blurred dashboard where the only legible string is 'Insights for you', wearing a video pause button. Its accounting fold is the real bar and it is good, dead flat and dense, but half of it is off-canvas: the Category column is sliced by the viewport edge and the last row fades out. Ours states more, more legibly, in one frame: five modules, a USD/EUR/AED toggle, search, filter, four customers with dates, amounts and three distinct statuses, and a Total, all readable at 100%, with two callouts that each terminate on a control that exists. THE ONE THING LEFT IS THE ARABIC BIDI SPLIT, AND IT IS THE SAME FAULT CLASS r11 KILLED, RELOCATED TO /ar/. The hero panel's cells compute direction:rtl, so the Latin customer name's trailing full stop jumps the string: at 3x it reads '.Northwind Trading Co', period on the LEFT. Its amounts print '‏4,820.50 US$' and render visually as '$US 4,820.50' in all five figures including the Total. The AppMockup 1,197px lower ON THE SAME ARABIC PAGE computes direction:ltr on the same cells and gets both right: 'Northwind Trading Co.' with the period where it belongs, and '$4,820.50'. So one Arabic page shows the same four invoices twice, and the amount carries a 'US' the second panel drops while a period sits on the wrong side of the only name that has one. Six cells differ, five figures and one name. No accounting product has ever printed '$US'. THE FIX: set dir='ltr' on the hero's customer and amount cells in src/pages/[...locale]/index.astro, exactly as AppMockup.astro already resolves them, or format the hero's figures through the same path AppMockup uses. Verify by asserting getComputedStyle(cell).direction === 'ltr' for the customer and amount cells on /ar/ and by reading the crop at 3x, because at page scale the flipped period is one glyph wide and invisible. Second, the panel still carries about 1.5deg of rotation against Wave's dead-flat screen; it is internally consistent, every row and its checkbox share the tilt, but flat is the more expensive read and the last degree is free.
